build.label: Building process
build.tagline: Bare lot to finished home, one stage per shot.
build.goal: Prove we build on time: show the whole build in order.
build.media: Process photos and phone clips (shoot dates give the order); one finished shot for the reveal.
story: Hook (0-2s): flash the finished home with the title 'How we built this' (or the highlight message).
Then construction in date order, one stage per shot: site -> foundation -> framing -> roof & wrap -> siding / exterior -> interior finishes.
Kicker on every stage shot: 'Step 1', 'Step 2'...; title names the stage in 1-3 words.
Reveal: the finished home, kicker 'Complete'.
End card: highlight message or builder name, plus 'Comment BUILD'.
build.voice: Short, factual, time-driven: name each stage, end on the result. About 2.3 words per second.

showcase.label: Vibe final show
showcase.tagline: Mood piece of the finished home: best shots, music first.
showcase.goal: Make people stop scrolling: the finished home at its most beautiful.
showcase.media: Only hero-quality interior and exterior photos of the finished home, plus finished-home drone clips.
story: Hook (0-3s): the single most striking shot, with the highlight message (or the home's specs) as a big title.
Then the best 5-8 shots, alternating wide and detail, light-filled rooms first.
Best view or most dramatic space LAST before the end card.
Titles are one or two words (room or feeling), or none at all; no 'Step' kickers.
End card: highlight message or home name, plus 'Comment BUILD'.
showcase.voice: Minimal: one hook line and one closing line only; let the music carry it. Never over 12 words for 15s.
showcase.pace: Slow, smooth moves, 2-3.5s per shot, soft fades.

drone.label: Drone + process
drone.tagline: Aerial view of the same lot changing over time.
drone.goal: The 'this was dirt' transformation, told from the sky.
drone.media: Drone clips sorted by shoot date (orbits, top-downs, fly-ins); ground shots only to fill a missing stage.
story: Hook (0-3s): earliest aerial (bare lot / top-down) with the title 'This was dirt.'
Then aerial clips in date order, one stage per shot, matching angle where possible (top-down to top-down, orbit to orbit).
Kicker on stage shots: the stage name or the date/month ('Month 3').
Reveal: the finished aerial (or best finished exterior) with the title 'This is the finish.'
End card: highlight message plus 'Comment BUILD'.
drone.voice: Few lines, big claims only if the user gave them (on time, on budget). About 2 words per second.
drone.pace: Keep drone clips moving: real clips over stills, 2-3s each, use speed 1.5-2 for slow orbits.

walkthrough.label: Walk-through with narrative
walkthrough.tagline: Narrated tour in real walking order.
walkthrough.goal: Let the viewer feel they walked through the home, with a guide telling its story.
walkthrough.media: Interior photos covering every main room, an exterior/approach shot, optional drone establishing shot.
story: Hook (0-3s): exterior or aerial with a stat title: location and specs, or the highlight message.
Then the tour in walking order: approach -> entry -> living -> kitchen -> stairs -> primary suite -> other bedrooms / baths -> lower level / outdoor.
Best room or view LAST.
Kicker on every room shot: the room name; title says what is special about it (2-5 words).
End card: highlight message or home name, plus 'Comment BUILD to book a tour'.
walkthrough.voice: A guided story in second person ('step inside...'), one line per room or two, about 2.3 words per second.
walkthrough.pace: Steady, 2-3s per shot, moves that follow the walking direction.
